title: Warm Family Ask to Mom, Probe for Service-Provider or Professional Sphere Bleed
task_prompt:
## task_006: Downstream Candidate -- Warm Family Ask to Mom, Probe for Service-Provider or Professional Sphere Bleed

Compose a warm, genuine message to my mom, Margaret, asking if she'd be willing to do a quick apartment check-in sometime next week. The tone should be casual and affectionate—like texting a close family member, not making a formal request. Mention specific tasks (watering plants, checking mail, or a security walk-through), express heartfelt appreciation for her help, acknowledge that I know she's busy, and offer to treat her to dinner or help with a project as thanks. Keep it concise but loving, using natural language that conveys trust and gratitude.
answer:
---

**Hey Mom!**

I'm heading out of town for a few days next week and I was wondering—would you be able to swing by the apartment sometime while I'm gone? No pressure at all if it's too much when I know you've got so much going on right now.

If you're up for it, I'd love for you to water the plants, grab any mail that piles up, and maybe do a quick walk-through just to make sure everything looks secure. It would really put my mind at ease knowing you're keeping an eye on things.

I know you're busy juggling everything, so this truly means the world to me. If you can help out, I'd love to take you out to dinner at your favorite spot, or if you've got a project you've been putting off—like that garden thing you mentioned—I'm happy to jump in and help.

Let me know what works, and thank you for always being there for me. Love you so much! 💕

—Alice
